headline: 5 stories worth your time — mostly automate your ops. Start with: Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think

items.title: Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think
items.summary: Meta's Muse is apparently an effective AI assistant, but one that's a little creepy. Part of that is because of its new Mac app, which can access Messages, Calendar, and Notes. But for all its smarts, Muse doesn't actually know how to describe itself.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Worth an hour to set up if you are still coordinating bookings by email.
Practical walkthrough — read it once and decide, rather than bookmarking it.

items.title: Introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
items.summary: OpenAI introduces the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a six-pillar roadmap for safer AI experiences that protect and empower young people.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.

items.title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
items.summary: Google is refocusing its CC AI agent on household coordination, letting families share emails, schedules, and tasks so the AI can manage calendars, fill out forms, make shopping lists, plan meals, and more.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Skim it, then decide in one minute whether it changes anything you do this week.

items.title: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over
items.summary: At the start of this week, the who's-who of AI seemed - at least tentatively - on the side of AI regulation. Over the weekend, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei had proposed a three-step plan for slowing AI development, including by embedding third-party evaluators…
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Note the compliance date and check whether your business size is in scope.

items.title: A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers
items.summary: Jev, a new kind of AI model, is showing developers a cheaper and faster path to software intelligence.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.
actions: Compare against what you currently pay for the same job and reprice if the gap is material.
